verdict.rationale: LibreOffice documents an official command-line interface with headless mode, batch `--convert-to` conversion with output directories, `--cat` text dumping to the console, batch print-to-file, input-filter forcing and macro invocation. A community user corroborates running it in Docker to generate PDFs and normalize formats. missing for 10: agent-oriented design such as structured/JSON output or machine-readable errors, CLI-level document editing beyond conversion/print/extract (that requires the UNO API or macros), and explicit hands-on corroboration of the CLI flags themselves.
